user.title: Ollama server
user.description: ParentControl rates running YouTube videos with a local Ollama model and pauses unsuitable ones. Afterwards each device gets switches for jumping to the start, educational value, swear words, and strict rating.

settings.title: Set up the check
settings.description: The rating comes from a language model and is not an official age rating. The first child applies to all selected devices; add more later in the options. Adults open the settings on the dashboard with the PIN.

error.cannot_connect: The Ollama server cannot be reached.
error.no_models: No model is installed on the Ollama server.
error.no_players: Select at least one media player.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.

data.pin: New PIN (leave empty to keep it)
data.warn_minutes: Warning before limit and end of viewing time (minutes)

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: An empty field restores the default text. After a change, videos are checked again.

lists.title: Lists for all children
lists.description: One entry per line. For allowed channels, the minimum age after a semicolon, for example: Die Maus; 0. Allowed swear words match whole words; "darn*" allows every word starting with darn.

profile_lists.title: Lists for {profile}
profile_lists.description: Applies in addition to the lists for all children. Whether the global allowed channels and words are inherited is set on the profile.

assign_player.title: Children for {device}
assign_player.description: Choose which children watch on this device. With several, the strictest rule applies.

error.no_players: Select at least one media player.
error.invalid_age: The allowed list contains an invalid age. Use 0 to 18.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
error.last_profile: At least one child must remain.
error.no_profile: Every device needs at least one child.

pin_blocked.message: Too many wrong attempts. The PIN is blocked for {minutes} more minutes.

no_pin.message: No PIN is set. An admin sets it in the integration options.

ollama_down.title: Ollama is unreachable
ollama_down.description: ParentControl has not reached the Ollama server for at least 10 minutes. Videos are not rated; without strict rating they keep playing.

yt_dlp_down.title: YouTube lookup fails
yt_dlp_down.description: yt-dlp has found no video data for at least 10 minutes. YouTube may have changed something; an update of ParentControl or yt-dlp can help.
